Description:

The straight high lines formed by the extra tall windows and the accompanying exterior decorative granite make the DuPont Mansion appear even taller.

It is located only 1 km from Churchill Downs in Historic Old Louisville.

Guestrooms blend modern amenities with a historic feel. Each room includes a flat-screen TV, free WiFi access, luxury linens and comfortable bedding. A spa bath and electric fireplace are provided in the rooms as well.

A gourmet breakfast is served each morning in the dining room. Guests can enjoy complimentary refreshments in the evening while relaxing with a book from the in-house library.

The Louisville Waterfront Park is 10 minutes drive from DuPont Mansion Historic Bed and Breakfast, while Speed Art Museum is 1.5 km away. The nearest airport is Louisville Airport, 7 km from the B&B.
